This is f*cking insane. Anthropic senior engineer:

"Most people type one prompt into one chat and think they've built an agent

I gave up on prompts. My agents live inside /loops + /graphs + /harness. Same model, same tokens, 10x more finished work, and it keeps shipping after I log off"

In a 1-hour course, she puts together a team of agents that repair their own failures and improve with nobody touching them

Prompt → Agent → Loop → Graph → Harness → A Team That Gets Better By Itself

Inside the loop, every agent plans, reviews its own output and tries again until it passes

The harness ties everything together: tools, memory and a way to recover when something breaks

Most people blame the model, when the actual problem is everything around it

Worth more than any $1,500 agent course

Save it and watch it today

Then read the full Opus 5.5 harness engineering guide below and build agents that bounce back from their own mistakes ↓
